description: This PHP source file defines the Event controller class for the OpenCart admin marketplace module. It handles listing, filtering, enabling, disabling, and deleting marketplace events through various methods, and interacts with models, views, and language files.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: Controller class for managing marketplace events in the OpenCart admin area. It provides functionalities for listing, filtering, enabling, disabling, and deleting events.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for displaying the event list page, setting up data, and rendering the view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the request to show the list of events by calling getList.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches filtered list of events, handles pagination, and prepares data for the view.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables selected events by changing their status to active.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables selected events by changing their status to inactive.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected events from the system.
